conditions.displayName: 3 or more checkers failing over 5 min

documentation.content:
The external check on __PUBLIC_URL__/readyz is failing from three regions: the service is down from the internet, which is where every laptop is.

`curl -i __PUBLIC_URL__/readyz` (expect 200 `ready`; 503 `not ready` is the database, anything else is Cloud Run or DNS). `gcloud run services describe loop-sessions --region=<region> --format='value(status.conditions)'` for the platform's view. If a deploy just landed, roll back: `gcloud run services update-traffic loop-sessions --region=<region> --to-revisions=<previous>=100`.

Runbook: examples/deploy-gcp/README.md#runbook-ingest-5xx
